description: This file implements OAuth2 authorization code flow endpoints for handling OAuth2 authorization, callback processing, and token refresh within the Flowise project. It manages credential data, constructs authorization URLs, exchanges authorization codes for tokens, updates credentials, and handles errors.

methods.name: router.post('/authorize/:credentialId')
methods.description: Initiates OAuth2 authorization flow by generating an authorization URL based on credential data.

methods.name: router.get('/callback')
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 callback, exchanges authorization code for tokens, updates credential data, and returns success or error HTML pages.

methods.name: router.post('/refresh/:credentialId')
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth2 access tokens using stored refresh token, updates credential data, and returns success or error response.
